composition_variation: Create a warm academic anime portrait of adult Gohan walking through a quiet autumn campus. Preserve his short angular black hair, dark eyes behind simple glasses, and gentle thoughtful adult expression. Dress him in a fully covering forest-green cardigan, cream shirt, tan trousers, and brown shoes. He holds two plain books comfortably against his torso while taking a natural easy step. Use golden gingko leaves near the path, red-brick hints, soft terracotta shadows, and a calm pale-blue upper sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
